services.name: Local toolchain
services.purpose: Node.js, pnpm, git, Docker for local development

steps.text: Install Docker Desktop (https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/) and start it
Install pnpm via corepack (corepack enable) and generate CRON_SECRET / AUDIT_IP_SALT with openssl rand -hex 32 into .env.local

services.name: Supabase
services.cost: Local: free. Cloud: free tier (limits; idle projects may pause); Pro plan recommended for production backups (TQ-4)

steps.text: supabase init && supabase start; copy API URL / anon key / service_role key from `supabase status` into .env.local
Create a Supabase account and organisation at https://supabase.com/dashboard
Run `supabase login` (browser) or create an access token (Account > Access Tokens) and put it in .env.local as SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
supabase projects create testko-ph-staging --region ap-southeast-1; supabase link; supabase db push
Approve creating the production project and choose the plan

services.name: Stripe
services.cost: No monthly fee; per-transaction fees. Account country support must be confirmed (OD-001)

steps.text: Create a Stripe account at https://dashboard.stripe.com/register (test mode is enough for local/staging)
Run `stripe login`; copy the test secret key (Developers > API keys) into .env.local as STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/v1/webhooks/stripe; owner pastes the printed whsec_ value into .env.local as STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Register the staging webhook endpoint via Stripe CLI/API with the events in TRD §7.1
Activate live mode (business verification) and approve live keys

services.name: PayPal Payouts
services.cost: Sandbox free; per-payout fees in live (confirm); Payouts must be enabled (OD-002)

steps.text: Log in at https://developer.paypal.com with a PayPal account
Apps & Credentials > Sandbox > Create App; put Client ID/Secret in .env.local; PAYPAL_API_BASE=https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com
Register the staging webhook via PayPal REST API (POST /v1/notifications/webhooks); owner copies the webhook id into env as PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID
PayPal Business account with Payouts enabled; approve live credentials

verify.local: agent runs an OAuth token request against the sandbox and reports success (no secrets printed)

steps.text: Create a Resend account at https://resend.com and an API key
Add the DNS records Resend shows for your sending domain (needs a domain, OD-008)
Send a test email and configure Supabase Auth SMTP settings

verify.staging: agent sends a test email to ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL

services.name: Vercel (web hosting + cron)
services.purpose: Host the Next.js app and run cron jobs (ADR-001, ADR-006)
services.cost: Free Hobby plan is for non-commercial use; the TRD assumes Pro (paid) for commercial use and sub-daily cron (A-016). A free commercial-friendly host would need a TRD update.

steps.text: Create a Vercel account at https://vercel.com and choose a plan
Run `vercel login`
vercel link; vercel env add (owner types each secret value at the prompt); vercel deploy
Run `gh auth login`
gh repo create (private) and push; gh secret set for CI (owner types values)
Create a Sentry account and a Next.js project at https://sentry.io; copy the DSN into env

verify.staging: agent triggers a test error and confirms it appears

steps.text: Buy the domain and give the agent access to edit DNS or apply records it lists
